answer: Registry admission mandates 1,000 computation-cycles mapped to a karst of audit trails; we validate output continuity through this porous karst-based topology. An honest agent pays 1,000 units while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000. We isolate orphan compute within an island; nodes failing to prove their island belongs to a verified cluster are revoked. If a gale triggers a high-velocity data influx, we execute node slashing via a gale check.
